sourceReview.unchangedClauseOwners: The publish-status acceptance report projection and validateSite registry identity checks retain their earlier logic; the new workflow schedules the complete deferred matrix in a separate required job.
sourceReview.proofHandoff: The deferred job executes the unchanged complete producer and uploads its executed receipt. The dependent test job always starts, fails immediately when the deferred job did not succeed, and otherwise downloads and validates the same-run receipt against source/specification/catalog/runtime/commit and all observations before reuse. Missing, failed, stale, corrupt, or incomplete receipts fail; direct verification without a receipt still runs the producer.
sourceReview.publicationGate: The test job now starts after any deferred-matrix outcome and its first unconditional step fails unless the matrix job succeeded. The protected test check therefore cannot pass through a skipped test job when matrix execution or upload fails. Artifact reuse still requires the completed PR test, successful deferred job and its execution/upload steps; the existing seal, deployed-byte check and live operator checks remain required.
sourceReview.testOnlyCorrections: The Stage 03 fixture still requires rejection of invalid nested targetId aliases, now asserted through both exact early nested-type rejection codes and paths; its conforming control passes. The scheduling fixture now asserts the separate checked producer and its 330-minute bounded budget while retaining failed, malformed, collector and direct execution controls. The evidence-owner assertion includes actual child stderr on failure. No product runtime rule was changed by these test corrections.
sourceReview.ingestionReceiptReuse: The executed-evidence consumer now requires and validates the exact current ingestion receipt when a receipt directory is configured, then uses its original reports and observations in all existing negative/ownership controls. Missing, stale, corrupt, or incomplete receipts fail; standalone execution without a receipt directory can still run the full owner with the existing bounded aggregate timeout. The shared producer helper accepts an explicit timeout without changing other callers.
sourceReview.ownerPopulation: The consumer exact-set oracle now includes the independently registered RESPONSE-CLOSED-FAMILY-BOUNDARY check. No owner assertion or negative case was removed; omitted, duplicate, or unregistered IDs still fail the exact comparison. Full corrected consumer execution remains required.
sourceReview.supplementalOwnerLinkage: The exact owner ID universe and required catalog check remain enforced. The normative trace assertion now applies to the 17 IDs declared by reviewed normative bindings, while an explicit one-ID supplemental set checks RESPONSE-CLOSED-FAMILY-BOUNDARY. Any further missing normative binding or supplemental catalog check fails.
sourceReview.browserPreview: The Stage 02 browser assertion checks the schema in the complete generated instruction, confirms the visible 65536-character preview is an exact prefix with export guidance, and checks the current file-first response guidance in the visible operator UI. It does not require a token beyond the preview cutoff to appear on screen.
sourceReview.requiredCheckSkipCorrection: The prior job-level success condition silently skipped the only branch-required test check on deferred failure. A job-level always() and first unconditional success guard preserve the same normal path and turn failure/cancellation/skipping into a red required test result. verified-site.mjs now requires that guard to have passed in a reusable artifact and rejects the old workflow; no product runtime source changed.
